What is the Explorer feed on Swipey AI?
Updated 15 days ago
The Explorer feed is Swipey AI's TikTok-style discovery feed at 
swipey.ai/feed
 ("Feed" on desktop, "Explore" on mobile). Scroll through reels, images and trending characters, then tap through to start chatting with anyone who catches your eye.
The Explorer feed is a Premium feature. Without Premium it appears blurred behind a "Premium eyes only" screen; that's expected, not a bug, and Join Premium unlocks it.
The feed shows Swipey's own characters, Verified Creators and trending content. Every video card has a mute button for sound. The more you explore, the better it gets at showing you characters you'll like.
Found a style you love? Use it as inspiration and create your own Custom AI.
QUICK FACTS:
TikTok-style feed at swipey.ai/feed, for Premium members Reels, images and trending characters Mute button on every video card Tap any character to start a chat
